newsitem.title: INDIA: India VSNL plans share issue in August.
newsitem.headline: India VSNL plans share issue in August.

text.p: India's state-run international telecommunications provider, Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL), said on Wednesday it planned to make a domestic stock offering in August.
"Our domestic issue will be in August and will be priced at a 15 per cent discount to the GDR price," B.K. Syngal, VSNL's chairman and managing director told Reuters in an interview.
Newspaper reports in the Indian press had earlier said VSNL's domestic issue would be in October 1997.
The company completed a $526.6 million global depository receipt (GDR) issue in March. It sold 37.8 million GDRs (one share to two GDRs) at a price of $13.93, or 1,000 rupees, each.
SBI Capital Markets Ltd, a unit of State Bank of India and Kotak Mahindra Finance Ltd would manage the domestic issue, Syngal said.
The company will offer 600,000 shares to domestic investors, at an average price of 850 rupees, he said.
